thesis: Hypothesis: a mobile service could appear at scattered rural origins. Supplied observations cannot establish travel demand or a service-area boundary.
objectives: Establish a single-query observed baseline over irregular rural origins.

lanes.label: Mobile bicycle repair across an irregular rural sample

next_actions: User-supplied: validate the hypothesis using a fresh, comparable real-world sample before making business decisions.
missing_evidence: Synthetic observations provide no evidence of real demand, conversion, revenue, or competitive causes.
